name: Pagination
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes AppicaUI (e.g. `Pagination(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

PaginationEllipsis.description: "…" for the pages collapsed out of a long range. Decorative, with a screen-reader-only "More pages" (translated).

PaginationItem.description: One <li>: a PaginationLink or a PaginationEllipsis.

PaginationLink.description: A page link (Button-styled). `active: true` is the current page - filled, aria-current="page" and not clickable; `disabled: true` dims an out-of-range control and removes it from the tab order. `icon: true` squares it around a lone icon (label it). A block taking an argument receives the attributes for your own element (a `button_to`, a Turbo frame link…).

PaginationList.description: The <ul> laying the pagination items out in a row.

PaginationPages.description:
The whole row for page `page:` of `pages:` - previous, the first and last pages, a `window:` of pages around the current one with ellipses for the gaps, and next. The block turns a page number into its URL. `edges: true` adds first / last jumps.

  Pagination { PaginationPages(page: @page, pages: @pages) { |page| posts_path(page:) } }

examples.name: Usage
examples.notes: PaginationPages renders the truncated range for `page:` of `pages:`; the block builds URLs.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "max-w-full overflow-x-auto [scrollbar-width:none]") do
    Pagination(variant:, size:, **given(aria_label:)) { PaginationPages(page:, pages:, window: window.to_i, edges:) { |number| "?page=#{number}" } }
  end
end

examples.name: Composed by hand
examples.notes:
The parts on their own: an icon previous control (disabled on page 1), the current page,
an ellipsis for the gap and the last page.

examples.name: Variants
examples.notes: `:outline` draws bordered buttons; `:soft` fills on hover. The current page is filled in both.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-col items-center gap-6") do
    %i[ outline soft ].each { |variant| Pagination(variant:) { PaginationPages(page: 1, pages: 4) { |number| "?page=#{number}" } } }
  end
end

examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "max-w-full overflow-x-auto [scrollbar-width:none]") do

examples.name: Buttons instead of links
examples.notes:
A block with an argument puts a link's attributes on your own element - here buttons that
update the page in place.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-col items-center gap-3", data: { demo: "pages" }) do
    p(class: "text-foreground-muted text-sm", data: { demo: "status" }) { "Page 1 of 5" }
    Pagination do
      PaginationList do
        1.upto(5) do |number|
          PaginationItem do
            PaginationLink(active: number == 1, aria_label: "Go to page #{number}") { |link| button(**link, type: "button", data: { **link[:data], page: number }) { number.to_s } }
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  script(type: "module") do
    raw safe(<<~JS)
      const demo = document.querySelector("[data-demo=pages]")
      const current = #{AppicaUI::PaginationLink::CURRENT.to_json}.split(" ")
      demo.addEventListener("click", ({ target }) => {
        const chosen = target.closest("[data-page]")
        if (!chosen) return
        demo.querySelectorAll("[data-page]").forEach(link => {
          const active = link === chosen
          link.classList.toggle("text-primary-foreground", active)
          current.forEach(name => link.classList.toggle(name, active))
          active ? link.setAttribute("aria-current", "page") : link.removeAttribute("aria-current")
        })
        demo.querySelector("[data-demo=status]").textContent = `Page ${chosen.dataset.page} of 5`
      })
    JS
  end
end

examples.notes: The chevrons flip with the reading direction.
